name: manual_a8314a
claim: Before hardcoding a new default model name in a provider config, verify it is actually pulled/loaded in the live runtime (e.g. curl the provider's own /api/tags or /v1/models) rather than assuming availability from a naming convention or another config file's reference to it.

decisions.notes: Confirmed qwen3.5:9b-nvfp4 was genuinely present in the local Ollama instance via /api/tags before making it Claude-Desktop-LLM's OLLAMA_MODEL default, since nvfp4 quantization has real hardware prerequisites and a wrong assumption would have broken out-of-box UX for anyone using the new default.

rationale: Confirmed qwen3.5:9b-nvfp4 was genuinely present in the local Ollama instance via /api/tags before making it Claude-Desktop-LLM's OLLAMA_MODEL default, since nvfp4 quantization has real hardware prerequisites and a wrong assumption would have broken out-of-box UX for anyone using the new default.
